messages:
sophia: starting cohorted blue/green for router v6 in eu-west1. plan: shadow 90s, then 5% limited to short-path cohort, step to 20% in cohort at +12m, evaluate, then decide full ramp. cookie affinity remains on old for dashboard routes. hold other deploys.
tom: ack. quiet window set 03:00-05:00 UTC. I'll watch /api/generate p95 and embedder errors.
ekaterina: request — pin admin/api-key-check to v5 until we confirm token rotation is stable. prefer header rule X-Admin=old.
sophia: added header rule: `lbctl add-rule --match \"header:X-Admin=old\" --path \"/admin|/api/key\" --backend v5-pin`
deploy-bot: [deploy] d-172888-11 started: router:v6 -> eu-west1. shadowing traffic -> OK.
oncall: initial traces show v6 cold start on some embedder RPCs. p95 +100ms on long-context only.
ekaterina: can we gate v6 by request length? add header X-Req-Len=short to route to v6.
sophia: doing: `lbctl route create --match \"header:X-Req-Len=short\" --backend v6` now.
deploy-bot: applying 5% cohort weight (short-path cohort). weights: cohort_short v6=5 v5=95.
tom: telemetry: short-path p95 roughly on par. long-context still pinned to v5. no 5xx on cohort.
infra-bot: warm pools for embedder increased to min_ready=8 for v6 backends.
ekaterina: suggestion: limit v6 concurrency to 6 to avoid bursty kernel issues.
sophia: set `routerctl backend set v6 --concurrency=6` and turned on prefix_cache=true for v6.
deploy-bot: cohort weight stepped to 20% (short-path cohort): v6=20 v5=80.
oncall: observing small increase in CPU steal in one AZ, correlated with v6 traffic. latency variance up but error rate flat.
tom: if steal persists we should reroute embedder v6 to fallback pool. infra-bot any thoughts?
infra-bot: identified noisy neighbor on node pool-a03. provisioning fallback pool embedder-fallback-eu and draining offending nodes.
sophia: rerouting v6 embedder to fallback pool: `infractl reroute embedder --from pool-a03 --to embedder-fallback-eu`
deploy-bot: reroute executed successfully.
oncall: after reroute p95 in cohort stabilizes, variance down ~25ms. recommend continue with cohort and keep long-context pinned.
ekaterina: recording decision: do not ramp long-context until kernel tuning INF-5100 is complete.
sophia: agreed. pausing automated full-ramp. manual approval needed to continue.
tom: I'll update release notes and mark the rollout as cohort-limited. please file follow-ups for kernel and node-placement.
ekaterina: also note to QA: re-run auth regression on pinned admin routes before next attempt.
sophia: creating follow-ups: INF-5100 (quant kernel tuning), INF-5101 (node placement policy), DOC-230 (release notes update).
deploy-bot: deployment d-172888-11 marked paused (manual continue).
oncall: ready to escalate to rollback if error rate rises above 0.5% or p95 delta >100ms for 5m.
sophia: thanks team. scheduling reattempt after kernel patch and prewarm. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
